summary.en-US: Hierarchical outline and timeline scrubber for Project Gutenberg books — jump chapters fast, scrub the whole text, and read in built-in dark mode.

description.en-US:
Project Gutenberg Outline turns long Gutenberg HTML books into something you can actually navigate.

When you open a book on gutenberg.org, the extension builds a structured outline and a right-edge timeline so you can move by chapter, subsection, or scroll position.

Features

  • Hierarchical outline — parts, chapters, and subsections.
  • Timeline scrubber — right-edge ticks with previews; wheel to step, click to jump.
  • Split peek — Shift+click to read in place.
  • Return to reading spot — Alt+Left after outline jumps.
  • Built-in book dark mode — toggle with ☾ or D; preference saved.

Privacy

  • Runs only on Project Gutenberg book HTML pages.
  • Permission: storage (dark-mode preference only).
  • No accounts, analytics, or remote code.

release_notes.en-US: Initial AMO release: hierarchical outline, timeline scrubber, split peek, return-to-spot, and built-in book dark mode for Project Gutenberg HTML texts.
